source.author: verg
source.text: Tertia sed postquam maiore hastilia nisu aggredior, genibusque adversae obluctor harenae eloquar, an sileam? gemitus lacrimabilis imo auditur tumulo, et vox reddita fertur ad auris:
source.text_original: Tertia sed postquam maiore hastilia nisu / aggredior, genibusque adversae obluctor harenae — / eloquar, an sileam? — gemitus lacrimabilis imo / auditur tumulo, et vox reddita fertur ad auris: /
source.text_english: But since I am taking up the third shaft with greater effort, and straining against the opposing sand with my knees, shall I speak, or keep silent? A pitiable groan is heard from the depths of the mound, and a voice is borne back to my ears:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: vox reddita tandem, vox horrenda viris; tum facta silentia vati:
reuse.text_original: vox reddita tandem, / vox horrenda viris; tum facta silentia vati: /
reuse.text_english: At last a voice was returned, a voice dreadful to the men; then silence was made for the seer:
